# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"an ore","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is an ore introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / yam:u1"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. It's a rare ore that can mostly be found in the {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:stone"}} layer in the overworld, most commonly at Y level 8.

It has a faint glow, making it easy to spot in a cave.

# Generation

Uranium ore has a different distribution to most other ores, since the generation of the {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:stone"}} and {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:deepslate"}} variants are run separately.

The stone variant {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:uranium_ore"}} is generated in one in every 6 chunks, with a triangular distribution of Y level 0 to 16 with a peak at Y level 8. It does not generate in {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:deepslate"}}.
The deepslate variant {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:deepslate_uranium_ore"}} is generated in one in every 14 chunks, with a triangular distribution of Y level -16 to 16 with a peak at Y level 0. It does not generate in {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:stone"}}.

This means {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_sky_and_stars:uranium"}} should be much more commonly mined in the {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:stone"}} layer, just before the transition layer into {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:deepslate"}}.

# Drops
A single piece of {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_sky_and_stars:uranium"}} is dropped when mined with a {{"of":"minecraft:item / minecraft:diamond_pickaxe"}} or higher.

{{"of":"minecraft:enchantment / minecraft:fortune"}} can be used to increase the drops when mined, with bonus drops calculated similar to {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:iron_ore"}} or {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:gold_ore"}},
